name: Peatlands and Natura Community Engagement Scheme
summary: Competitive fund for community and local organisations running peatland and Natura 2000 site projects such as conservation management, monitoring, invasive species and fire control, funding 80% of costs. The 2026 call is closed; the page does not say whether it recurs.

amount.note: Up to 80% of project costs; maximum EUR 20,000 for non-Natura peatland sites

status.quote: is now open for applications for 2026 with a closing date of 09 January 2026

deadline.quote: is now open for applications for 2026 with a closing date of 09 January 2026

applicant_types.quote: The Scheme aims to encourage communities, local organisations and other interested parties to become involved in the enhancement of their natural surrounding areas

access.quote: Details of the Terms and Conditions of the Scheme and Application Form needed to apply are available via the links below

window.quote: This is a competitive fund, with up to €800,000 available in 2026.

amount.quote: Category 1 - Natura 2000 sites (SAC / SPA) The maximum grant available is 80% of the costs of the project to a maximum of €40,000 Category 2 - Non-Natura Peatland sites (incl. NHA and undesignated sites) The maximum grant available is 80% of the cost of the project to a maximum of €20,000
